headline: Paraguayan Senate Approves Ueno Bank Depositor Payout Advance
summary: Paraguay's Senate modified the deposit guarantee law to advance payments to Ueno Bank depositors by 24 hours, covering up to 40 minimum wages, following the detention of eight bank executives.
why: Regulatory interventions and executive detentions at commercial banks impact local liquidity, depositor confidence, and financial sector stability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Ueno Bank
impacts.why: Executive detentions and government interventions create severe operational and reputational stress for the bank.
